description: Sums a polyphonic stereo signal down to one stereo pair, with a level knob for each of the sixteen channels

params.text: Sets the level of its channel in the sum, 0 to 1
Sets the level of the whole sum, 0 to 100 per cent

inputs.text: The left signal, one channel per source to be mixed
The right signal, one channel per source to be mixed
Scales every channel level by cable, 0-10V mapped onto nothing to full, one channel of this jack per channel of the signal
Scales the main level by cable, 0-10V mapped onto nothing to full

outputs.text: The left channels added together as one monophonic signal
The right channels added together as one monophonic signal

notes: the lamps show the level of the two outputs, from -60dB at the bottom to 0dB at the top
the number of channels summed is that of whichever of InL and InR carries more, so a monophonic cable in one of them does not cut the other short
menu: Level Input — opens a slider setting how quickly the module follows a change at either level jack, which keeps a gate patched there from clicking

inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads full level; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.3:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads full level; a negative voltage does nothing here.
